attr.title: NHL 95 PC
attr.desc: EA Sports NHL 95 for DOS, hosted by Overbar on SDL2. Overlay on Select. Bring your own installed game and CD files. aarch64 native binary is a later build; this zip is the PortMaster layout.
attr.inst: Copy the installed NHL 95 folder into nhl95pc/gamedata/ (HOCKEY.EXE and data) and the CD files into nhl95pc/cd/. No ISO.
